title: Advice for parents of teenagers
instruction: Write one word in each gap.

passage.text: You’ve always (1) ___ up your children to come to you when they’re in trouble.
You feel it’s your job to (2) ___ after them when they’re having problems.
But now, as your children are (3) ___ up, they often don’t want to share their problems with you.
Of course, you want to (4) ___ on well with your children, but that means you have to give them some freedom.
Maybe they’ve (5) ___ out with their best friend and feel upset and angry.
Maybe they’ve just (6) ___ up with the boyfriend or girlfriend they’ve been (7) ___ out with.
Maybe they’ve just (6) split up with the boyfriend or girlfriend they’ve been (7) ___ out with.
Maybe they’ve been (8) ___ down by a friend who they trusted.
